headline.text: L1 S4 conbar motor stopped at 21:35 after degrading through second shift — runtime dropped from 6 minutes to *30–60 seconds* before final shutdown.

per_plant_summary.L1: S3 ran caramel cluster with multiple brief pauses for Z-conveyor cleaning and accumulation, all cleared same-shift. S2 had metal detector failure that resolved in under an hour, then ran through two caramel supply pauses. S4 conbar motor degraded through second shift and stopped at 21:35.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 completed morning CIL clean by 08:21 and resumed production. VFFS completed lot changeover 62R to 63A and flagged cross-contamination from L3 pallets. ML3 had brief film-paste stop at roll change, cleared in 5 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 completed level 2 deep clean and passed ATP by 06:57. ML1 ran with temper adjustments through the night and has clogged nozzle in progress as of 06:50. MF Matrix level 2 clean passed ATP at 01:50.

resolved.title: S2 metal detector failed card test at 15:32
resolved.summary: Metal detector failed to read test cards during routine check; line paused immediately, product from 14:30–15:30 isolated for hold.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance made adjustments, cards passed by 15:54. X-ray verified with 3 passes per card. One WIP pallet from 15:10 placed on hold; no pouch pallets affected.

resolved.title: S3 MM4/5 suction cup jam causing accumulation
resolved.summary: Ripped suction cups on MM4 and MM5 pouch height mechanism caused 220 pouch scrap and 15-minute line pause at 08:52.
resolved.resolution: Replaced suction cups and adjusted pouch height by 09:07 — "now running better" (Nathan). Operations resumed 09:08.

resolved.title: S2 warm caramel jammed slitter at startup
resolved.summary: Caramel too warm passing through slitter and separation table; line stopped at 15:43, then jammed at 17:15 when operator couldn't remove cut piece in time.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned separating belts, prevented buildup from damaging slitter, reassembled. Line restarted 17:38 with caramel at guillotine, running fine by 18:17.

resolved.title: S3 ran out of caramel twice on second shift
resolved.summary: Line paused at 18:19 and 21:16 due to buffer tank empty; cooking times at 43 and 52 minutes, unable to keep pace with line speed.
resolved.resolution: Reduced line speed to 65 instead of caustic clean (third shift only 4 hours). Resumed 18:46 and 21:36 after buffer tank filled.

resolved.title: S3 Z-conveyor roller buildup recurring
resolved.summary: Z-conveyor bottom roller accumulated caramel buildup requiring cleaning at 09:48, 18:46, and 21:34 to avoid friction and damage.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned during pauses at 09:48 (10 min), 18:46 (during caramel wait), and 21:34 (during caramel wait). Replacement belt shipped from Springville at 15:00.

resolved.title: ML3 film didn't paste at roll exchange
resolved.summary: Flow wrapper film failed to paste during roll changeover at 18:27, line down.

resolved.title: ML2 CIL cleaning pause
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 07:48 for clean-in-line maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Clean completed, line running up at 08:21.

resolved.title: ML4 level 2 deep clean and micro hold
resolved.summary: Deep clean required with micro lab samples before resuming use; mixer drive wear found but no product contamination risk.
resolved.resolution: Clean completed by 06:57. Passed ATP, allergen, and micro collection. Gondola, long belt, and TG5 all verified.

needs_attention.title: S4 conbar motor windings failing
needs_attention.summary: Motor degraded through second shift from 6-minute runtime to 30–60 seconds before faulting; maintenance tried cooling solutions but windings continuing to fail.
needs_attention.status: Line stopped at conbar at 21:35. Caleb York: "motor is on its final legs" — cooling not helping, runtime dropping continuously. Decision made at 21:06 to watch 30 mins then shut down.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM3 green feeder belt not working
needs_attention.summary: Green feeder belt on MM3 failed, maintenance dispatched to repair.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 02:18. No resolution posted before line finished at 03:21.

needs_attention.title: S2 cavanna accumulation due to dirty equipment
needs_attention.summary: Cavannas causing lots of accumulation on third shift; operators believe equipment is dirty and needs CILT.
needs_attention.status: Pausing to pass accumulation and do CILT as of 03:24. No completion posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: L3 placing wrong WIP on top of VFFS pallets
needs_attention.summary: Twice found loose WIP (truffle product and Hershey caramel in red packaging) placed on top of 21140 pallets from VFFS, cross-contamination risk.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Alan Todd at 04:49 to follow up with L3. No response or resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML2 10 pallets need re-wrapping
needs_attention.summary: 10 finished pallets wrapped with insufficient film, cannot ship as-is, need to be re-wrapped.
needs_attention.status: Flagged to Alex Mendoza and Gustavo Rodas at 19:11 to talk with operators about proper wrapping. Pallets identified but not yet re-wrapped.

needs_attention.title: ML1 clogged nozzle on depositor
needs_attention.summary: Depositor nozzle clogged at 06:34, blocking flow.
needs_attention.status: Still working to unclog at 06:50, reported "almost done" but no final clear posted.
